description: This file declares the LifecycleManagerImplementation class, which implements lifecycle management interfaces, event handling, and application context management within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It includes class definitions, method signatures, and internal data members related to application lifecycle events and notifications.

classes.name: LifecycleManagerImplementation
classes.description: Implements lifecycle management, state management, configuration, and event handling for applications within the plugin framework. Manages notifications, application contexts, and dispatches lifecycle events.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: Represents a dispatched job for handling lifecycle events asynchronously, with reference counting and dispatch logic.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification interface for lifecycle management.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification interface for lifecycle management.

methods.name: GetLoadedApps
methods.description: Retrieves a list of loaded applications, optionally verbose.

methods.name: IsAppLoaded
methods.description: Checks if a specific app is loaded.

methods.name: SpawnApp
methods.description: Starts a new application with specified parameters.

methods.name: SetTargetAppState
methods.description: Sets the desired state for an application instance.

methods.name: SendIntentToActiveApp
methods.description: Sends an intent to the active application.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification for lifecycle state changes.

methods.name: StateChangeComplete
methods.description: Indicates completion of a state change for an app.

methods.name: CloseApp
methods.description: Closes an application with a specified reason.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the lifecycle manager with the provided service.
